In the 104-week early-start vs delayed-start comparison, M-side estimate −0.172 (SE 0.087, p=.05), L-side −0.041 (SE 0.069, p=.55); Table 2 marks the direction for less progression as negative. Exploratory, uncorrected contrasts, with all participants receiving prasinezumab in year 2. Related clinical endpoint context only; no raw-fig exposure. Exact frozen pair: raw fig / rest tremor severity.
